description: Delete the pro page of the person you act for (or this key's own), for good: the page, its LinkedIn tick and old checks are deleted, it leaves /hands and the directory, and its @handle is freed for anyone. Invitations already on a call's list and the public record of their work stay. Says what goes by default; call again with confirm: true to sign. Spends nothing.

confirm.description: false (the default) says what goes; true signs and removes the page.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).
